INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Word Processing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing.

2. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

4. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards
